raw_proposal.draft:
Hi [Customer Name],

Thank you for reaching out to Cedar Systems. We understand that your facilities management team is looking for improved regional coordination through workflow coordination and account reporting. We are happy to schedule a discovery meeting to better understand your specific integration requirements and how we can support your needs.

Please let us know a convenient time for you, and we will be in touch shortly.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
Cedar Systems Team
[Contact Information]
questions: What is the preferred time for the discovery meeting?
Are there any specific departments or stakeholders that should be included in the meeting?
